name: insert_fit
declaration: unsafe fn insert_fit (mut self , key : K , val : V ,) -> Handle < NodeRef < marker :: Mut < 'a > , K , V , marker :: Leaf > , marker :: KV >
parent: Handle < NodeRef < marker :: Mut < 'a > , K , V , marker :: Leaf > , marker :: Edge >
documentation:
Inserts a new key-value pair between the key-value pairs to the right and left of
 this edge. This method assumes that there is enough space in the node for the new
 pair to fit.
rules: The node containing this edge must have enough space for the new key-value pair to fit.
